A '''spire''' served as the headquarters of the electronics manufacturer [[ChandrilTech]]. Located in downtown [[Emita/Legends|Emita]], a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Ananta]] continent of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], the spire was at least 105 stories tall and handled most of the company's corporate functions.<ref name="Strongholds" />

The spire had a massive atrium made of [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. Apart from the atrium, the building's first fifty floors were used for advertising and sales. The following twenty stories were devoted to administrative services such as taxes and payrolls, while the next thirty were used for research and development. The spire's top five floors were used by ChandrilTech's [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]], [[Hella Thimram]], as well as by the company's [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprexes]], an administrative body.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The spire was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
